items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: The interviewee discusses his band members (Kid Sheik, Eddie Summers, Phillip Gilbert, Albert Glampion). The interviewer mentions 'Ken' in relation to 'Clannett' and 'brothers', but the interviewee does not mention Ken, nor does he confirm a personal or professional relationship with Ken. Ken appear

ctx.x: Between the band, uh, Kid Sheik, Eddie Summers, I think it was, uh, what's Phillip Gilbert's name? Phillip Gilbert on drum. And, uh, Irvin, uh, Glampion. Clannett.
Clannett. Is he the last time to Ryman? Yeah. He's Ken the... Yeah. Right. Yeah. Played his brothers. Brother. Brother. And you had a vice band?
I had, I had a, we had a, uh, banjo, was Albert Glampion.
